description: This file defines the interface and classes for socket port management within the Thunder core namespace. It includes class declarations for SocketPort, SocketStream, SocketDatagram, and SocketListner, along with associated enums, methods, and internal logic for socket operations, state management, and network communication handling.

classes.name: SocketPort
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a network socket port, providing core functionalities for socket management, state handling, data transmission, and network operations.

classes.name: SocketStream
classes.description: Derived class for stream-oriented socket communication, supporting raw and standard stream sockets.

classes.name: SocketDatagram
classes.description: Derived class for datagram-oriented socket communication, supporting raw and standard datagram sockets.

classes.name: SocketListner
classes.description: Class managing listening sockets, accepting incoming connections, and handling socket events.

classes.name: SocketListner::Handler
classes.description: Internal class within SocketListner that extends SocketPort to handle incoming connection events.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the socket port.

methods.name: RemoteNode
methods.description: Sets the remote node identifier for the socket port.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the socket (DATAGRAM, STREAM, etc.).

methods.name: IsListening
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in listening state.

methods.name: IsConnecting
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in connecting state.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket is suspended.

methods.name: IsForcedClosing
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in a forced closing state.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has encountered an error.

methods.name: LocalNode
methods.description: Returns the local node identifier.

methods.name: LocalNode (setter)
methods.description: Sets the local node identifier.

methods.name: RemoteNode
methods.description: Returns the remote node identifier.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of the remote node.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of the local node.

methods.name: ReceivedNode
methods.description: Returns the node identifier of the last received message.

methods.name: ReceivedInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface identifier of the received message.

methods.name: SendBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the send buffer.

methods.name: ReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the receive buffer.

methods.name: SocketSendBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket's send buffer size.

methods.name: SocketReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket's receive buffer size.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Resets internal counters for bytes sent and received.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Gets or sets the Time To Live (TTL) value for the socket.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Enables or disables broadcast on the socket.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast group.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket with optional specific interface.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers socket event handling.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Abstract method to send data through the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Abstract method to receive data from the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events for the socket.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Puts the socket into listening mode.

methods.name: Accept (overload)
methods.description: Accepts a connection and retrieves remote node info.

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the socket handle.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the socket port.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Sets the socket error state.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the internal critical section.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the internal critical section.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Generates a string identifier for a node.

methods.name: SocketMode
methods.description: Determines the socket mode based on type.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns socket event flags.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the socket as opened.

methods.name: Accepted
methods.description: Marks the socket as accepted.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs read operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs write operation.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Aligns buffer for socket.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Constructs a socket with given parameters.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits for socket to open.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for socket to close.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits for write operation to complete.
